name: Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones
description: Premium over-ear wireless headphones with active noise cancellation, 30-hour battery life, ultra-comfortable memory foam ear cushions, and Hi-Res audio support. Features Bluetooth 5.3, multipoint connection, and a fold-flat design for travel.

name: Slim Fit Organic Cotton T-Shirt
description: Essential everyday tee crafted from 100% organic combed ring-spun cotton. Features a modern slim fit, reinforced neck seam, and pre-shrunk fabric. Available in 12 colors. Machine washable.

name: Minimalist Leather Watch
description: A refined timepiece featuring a genuine Italian leather strap, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal glass, Japanese quartz movement, and a ultra-slim 8mm stainless steel case. Water resistant to 50m. Comes in a gift box.

name: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: Rugged IPX7 waterproof Bluetooth speaker delivering rich 360-degree sound with deep bass. Offers 20 hours of playtime, built-in microphone for calls, USB-C charging, and a carabiner clip for on-the-go use.

name: Ceramic Pour-Over Coffee Set
description: Handcrafted ceramic pour-over coffee dripper with a double-wall borosilicate glass carafe (600ml), reusable stainless steel mesh filter, and a bamboo lid. Designed for optimal extraction temperature retention.

name: Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Serum
description: A lightweight, fast-absorbing facial serum formulated with hyaluronic acid, vitamin C, and niacinamide. Dermatologist-tested, fragrance-free, and suitable for all skin types. 30ml / 1 fl oz bottle.

name: Premium Yoga Mat — Extra Thick
description: Eco-friendly 6mm thick TPE yoga mat with dual-layer non-slip texture, alignment guide lines, and a carrying strap. Free from PVC, latex, and toxic glues. Measures 183cm x 68cm. Ideal for yoga, pilates, and stretching.

name: The Art of Clean Code — Hardcover
description: A comprehensive guide to writing maintainable, readable, and efficient code. Covers SOLID principles, design patterns, refactoring techniques, test-driven development, and practical code smells. 384 pages. Published by O'Reilly Media.
